origin.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup, editorial architectural photography.
Asset type: furniture homepage lounge scene, landscape 16:10, no text or UI.
Primary request: create a premium workplace lounge photograph using the supplied Creva modular sofa reference. Preserve the exact sofa's recognizable geometry: lightly upholstered beige three-seat corner composition, slim rectangular pale oak feet, low straight arms and separate soft rectangular back cushions. Do not turn it into a generic rounded sofa. The sofa is the primary subject, rendered at believable real scale with fine woven upholstery.
Scene: a quiet office social area in a contemporary European interior. Warm white plaster wall, pale stone floor, light oak wall section, very restrained muted sage fabric acoustic panel. A small low light oak coffee table with a single ceramic vessel, a floor plant in the far corner. Large unseen window at left provides soft morning daylight, natural physical contact shadows under all sofa feet. No people, no busy decor, no chairs.
Composition: landscape 16:10, sofa centered slightly right, all feet and the entire corner shape visible. Camera at normal eye level, 45mm lens, careful architectural framing, no wide-angle distortion. Slightly closer view than the workspace image but roomy margins around the sofa. Harmonize with a warm white, cream, sage, graphite and natural oak website; keep the background calm and furniture clear. Photoreal editorial architectural photography with subtle material texture, no fake logos, watermark, lettering, model codes or unrealistic bent geometry. This is an interior inspiration visualization, not a completed client project.
